subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes handing the confession to Kalan is the right move because Kalan got fired and deserves to save face.
source_quote: Kalan had gotten fired. That's the terrain — a man told he was done, standing next to a case he couldn't crack, that we cracked for him. You don't take a win off a man like that. You hand it to him and let him stand a little taller.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wants to fly under the radar rather than become famous.
source_quote: Okay, the alternative: if we make a big deal about being the ones who cracked it, that plays into our fame. But do we really want to be famous, or do we want to fly under the radar? That's kind of our—

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is unsure whether Dawnbringer is male or female and admits he can't remember.
source_quote: I don't know, I can't remember.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes Dawnbringer is female and accepts that label.
source_quote: Whatever — she. Yeah, I think we said she.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks there must be a book in the library that can prove Bookwyrm's guilt.
source_quote: There's got to be a book somewhere in the library we can use to actually get to the bottom of this. Some sort of magic book. A powerful spell.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wants to use their reward to obtain a book that can prove Bookwyrm's culpability after the fact.
source_quote: I'm just thinking — the reversal here is: we go in, we say here are the people that did it, we get a reward, and one of us uses that reward to get the book that can then prove she did it.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes being infamous underground has not served them well.
source_quote: We're already infamous underground. It didn't seem to serve us well.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is skeptical of Kalan’s academic principles when they conflict with justice.
source_quote: But from your own perspective — isn't that immoral? We're effectively preventing Bookwyrm, if innocent, from serving this role.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir suspects Kalan is acting out of self-preservation, not principle.
source_quote: He said his own name as he said it, the way a man does when he's decided to be honest about his cowardice and dress it as principle.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz relies on the option of hacking and slashing as a comforting contingency plan.
source_quote: If things go sideways, we can always start hacking and slashing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes patience is a viable strategy if it leads to action.
source_quote: Wait and see if people figure it out.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch refuses to sneak or use stealth to trap Bookwyrm with Zone of Truth.
source_quote: I will not sneak this time. We will walk in, and we will boldly demand that she submit to a Zone of Truth.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch intends to give Bookwyrm an opportunity to decline submission to Zone of Truth to weaken her politically.
source_quote: I will give her the opportunity to decline.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch believes the best way to destroy Bookwyrm is through humiliation and political removal, not legal conviction.
source_quote: If she's removed from her position as an avowed, that would be far more damning than any crime we could convict her of.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch is genuinely pleased to be given a new research problem: identifying a book that can prove Bookwyrm’s culpability.
source_quote: Kalan paused, and thought, and looked genuinely pleased to have a problem he could research.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch intends to find a book that will prove Bookwyrm's guilt after the naming ceremony.
source_quote: I will come up with such a book before you leave.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalls having done similar political maneuvers in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: I have seen this move before, in Gracklstugh, dressed in different robes.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes Bookwyrm is covering for family because he understands the arithmetic of that kind of loyalty.
source_quote: I know the arithmetic of that. I have done it for a mushroom.

subject: Dawnbringer's identity
fact: Dawnbringer's gender is unresolved and unknown to Thorin, despite their connection.
source_quote: I don't know, I can't remember.

subject: The book to prove Bookwyrm's guilt
fact: The specific book Thorin and Kalan intend to find to prove Bookwyrm's culpability has not yet been identified.
source_quote: I don't know which book exactly, but I'm just thinking.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realizes the word 'infamous' means 'extra famous' and says it aloud.
source_quote: Infamous," I said. "You know that's supposed to mean extra famous.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices Dawnbringer making noises in his head and interprets it as communication.
source_quote: She could make noises in my head, so — yeah. That was answer enough for the mechanics of it.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notices that Kalan did not discount the confession when listing evidence.
source_quote: He said: you have a confession. A heart and a cleaver. Right — but he didn't discount the confession.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum did not correct Thorin's theatrics because he knew theater is the work, and he of all people knows that.
source_quote: I did not correct the theatrics. The name for the move was not wrong. And theater is the work; I of all people know that.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum marked in the margin that they had come all this way to convict a woman not of murder but of embarrassment.
source_quote: I only took notes and marked, in the margin, that we had come all this way to convict a woman not of murder but of embarrassment

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed Bahamut may or may not have been reading over his shoulder.
source_quote: Bahamut may or may not have been reading over my shoulder. I wrote it down either way.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to touch the cup of tea.
source_quote: Daz did not touch the cup in front of him.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin refused to drink the tea.
source_quote: Yeah, I'm not drinking the tea, that's for sure,

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum lifted the cup and let the tea run down into Glabbagool instead of down his throat.
source_quote: I lifted the cup, tilted it to my mouth, and let the tea run down into Glabbagool instead of down my throat.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum told Glabbagool to stay still because it was a moment of quiet reflection.
source_quote: I had told him first, low, that this was a moment of quiet reflection. No loud noises.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed Glabbagool stayed still because he was asked to, and that was discipline, or the beginning of it.
source_quote: He stayed still because I asked him to. That is discipline, or the beginning of it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the woman was not sad but relieved.
source_quote: Daz caught it too — I saw him go quiet and still, the way he does when he's found the seam in a thing. She was not sad. She was relieved.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the woman had already decided she'd won.
source_quote: She had decided. Her hands were too relaxed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed the woman said 'beloved by all'.
source_quote: Did she actually say 'beloved by all'? Of course she did. Beloved by all.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized the woman did not have the sapphire when the spell found nothing.
source_quote: I reached out with the spell and found nothing where the sapphire should have been. Bookwyrm did not have it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed the woman was sincerely afraid something would happen to them.
source_quote: I looked at her while she said it and found, underneath, that she meant the worry. It was real — she was sincerely afraid something would happen to us.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the woman was delighted to have them wrapped up and out of everything.
source_quote: Daz found the other half, the half I only saw land on his face: she was delighted to have us wrapped up and out of everything, no more heads poking anywhere.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum's Glabbagool arm swiped the potion of flying off the table.
source_quote: While she was talking, I had my Glabbagool arm swipe the potion of flying off the table.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool thought the flying skill was a good skill.
source_quote: Glabbagool liked the flying skill. He thought it was a good skill.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool offered that he liked the flying skill.
source_quote: I like the flying skill," he offered. "That was a good skill.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed the room stopped looking at the safe and started looking at each other after finding the red herring coin.
source_quote: The whole room understood that at once, and at once stopped looking at the safe and started looking at each other.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed Daral had stopped bragging and was complimenting the party up and down.
source_quote: He'd stopped bragging. That was new. He was complimenting the party up and down, which for Daral was a kind of surrender.

subject: Daral
fact: Daral feared being left broken because the party had decided he wasn't worth the spell.
source_quote: under the scholarship, the small fear of being left broken because we'd decided he wasn't worth the spell

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was still weighing whether to cure Daral.
source_quote: I mean, if he's… I don't know," Daz said, which is Daz for *I'm still weighing it, and it hasn't landed yet.*

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed Fembris Lancer had no reservations about the food.
source_quote: Fembris, on the other hand, had no such reservations — come, come, come, already reaching, all appetite and no suspicion.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum understood that Daz's number '118' meant Fembris had been promoted as taster.
source_quote: Daz offered, which meant nothing to Fembris and everything to us

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the Underdark taught him to spend the cheap risk before the dear one, and he had never regretted the lesson.
source_quote: The Underdark teaches you to spend the cheap risk before the dear one, and I have never once regretted the lesson.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes a man shouldn't sit in his own rot while others debate his usefulness.
source_quote: But a man shouldn't sit in his own rot while four strangers debate his usefulness.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wanted to cast lesser restoration himself but held his tongue because the room was moving toward mercy.
source_quote: So I held my tongue and let the room work it out, because it was working itself toward mercy, which is the only direction I ever need it to go.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum did not correct Zalthir’s implication that Daz might extort Daral.
source_quote: I did not correct him. The read was not wrong.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thought the interaction between Daral and Dawnbringer was a small good thing in a room full of guards.
source_quote: I thought, *there it is, a small good thing in a room full of guards.*

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes relationships are complicated, but the one between Daral and Dawnbringer was simple.
source_quote: These relationships are so complicated. This one, for once, was simple.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is convinced that the helmed horrors were sent to retrieve the key in Daz’s pocket.
source_quote: They weren't following a face. They were following the key itself, sniffing it out through plate and pocket both.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum knows he has plenty of heal spells and Revivify, and is not worried about Daz going down.
source_quote: Don't worry, I've got plenty of heal spells, buddy. If you get knocked out, I'll just heal you — you'll be back up in no time. I also have Revivify, so we're covered either way.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes the ground under one’s feet says what your mouth doesn't need to.
source_quote: The giants taught me that before I could carry a shield — you don't chase, you position, and the ground under your feet says what your mouth doesn't need to.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed that the helmed horrors went for Daz first, then for him when the key changed hands.
source_quote: The suits had gone straight for Daz, then straight for Grygum the second the key changed hands.

subject: Who sent the helmed horrors
fact: The identity of who sent the helmed horrors is unknown and unresolved.
source_quote: Somebody built these, aimed them, and put them through the windows knowing exactly which pocket to reach for.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum stepped up and unleashed a burst of clean light that caught two helmed horrors at once.
source_quote: Grygum stepped up and let go a burst of clean light that caught two of them at once, both flinching under it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum kept his feet steady as the last helmed horror reached for him, refusing to be moved.
source_quote: Grygum kept his feet like the floor was the one thing he wasn't giving up.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum handed the key back to Daz after it had been passed to him.
source_quote: When Grygum handed the key to Daz — who saw it?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is confident Daz will be fine, even after being hit by a helmed horror.
source_quote: Don't you worry, Daz. You're going to be fine. Totally fine.
